prompt: Productize the Verrail frontend by replacing Infrastructure and Governance route indexes with Paperclip-style contextual navigation, retaining real functionality and proving end-to-end usability before PR creation.
allowed_actions: Audit the current local frontend and Paperclip Settings reference
Edit canonical documentation, routes, layout, navigation components, localized copy, and focused tests
Reuse existing functional pages behind canonical Verrail section routes
Run local UI, browser, typecheck, build, design-token, bundle, and focused regression checks
Create repo-native delivery records and screenshots
forbidden_actions: Add fake or nonfunctional management pages
Change backend data authority or implement deferred domain capability
Push, create a pull request, merge, deploy, release, self-approve, or create a ship record
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run <focused frontend tests>
expected_evidence: Before and after screenshots for Governance, Infrastructure, and Settings reference
Desktop and narrow-desktop browser journey with zero page and console errors
Typecheck, build, token, bundle, locale parity, and diff results
stop_conditions: A required page has no real implementation behind it
The change would require deleting compatibility routes or changing backend authority
Persistent browser or server failure prevents current-run visual verification
A scoped regression cannot be resolved without expanding beyond the target
